and experiments

Market and research

Manage up to 4 independent panels

indicators and signals
View news and sentiment
Analyze supplied text

Strategy lifecycle
Browse single/composite strategies
Create manual composite
Draft from text, DSL or approved URL
Review, approve and version
Deploy reviewed trusted plugin
